title: Dog
label: Dog
blurb: A Labrador-type dog, with its body, muscles, bones, organs, nerves and blood vessels. Click any part, or use the layer buttons.
model_note: A model built from typical proportions of a medium-sized dog (a Labrador-type male, 30 kg, 57 cm at the withers), not a scan of one animal. Bone shapes, muscle outlines and organ sizes are schematic; the counts (7 neck, 13 chest, 7 lower-back vertebrae, 13 pairs of ribs, 42 teeth) are real.

legend.title: On the cut face
legend.note: The dog is cut along its midline: look at it from the side first, then press the button. A schematic section: the pale blue-grey is sketched, not a scan.

legend.title: In the heart
legend.note: A simplified cut through a model heart: the wall thicknesses, the chamber shapes and the valve positions are schematic, not measured.

legend.title: In the eye
legend.note: A model eye with a schematic layout. Look at the dog from the side, then press the button; the cut passes through the middle of the eye.

legend.title: In the nose

items.name: Scrolls at the back: the smell lining
Scrolls at the front: the airway lining

legend.note: The turbinate scrolls are drawn as a schematic: the real ones are far more finely folded and branched. Look from the side, then press the button.

legend.title: In the ear
legend.note: A schematic of the ear, not to scale in the inner ear. Look at the dog from the front, then press the button; the cut passes across the head.
